question: Which of the following is the local name of Dussehra festival celebrated in the state of Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kullu Dussehra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kullu Dussehra** is a renowned festival celebrated in the **state of Himachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• This festival is unique in comparison to Dussehra celebrations in other parts of India as it does not involve the burning of **Ravana effigies**.
 
• The celebrations take place in **Kullu Valley**, specifically at the **Dhalpur Maidan**, and last for **seven days**, starting on the day of Vijayadashami.
 
• The festival is marked by a grand procession in which the local deities from villages in the valley are carried to the Dhalpur Maidan, symbolizing their assembly under the presiding deity, **Lord Raghunath**.
 
• The event attracts a large number of **devotees, tourists, and cultural enthusiasts** from across the world, making it a significant cultural spectacle.
 
• The festival is believed to have started in the **17th century** when Raja Jagat Singh of Kullu installed an idol of Lord Raghunath as the ruling deity of the valley.
 
• The week-long celebration includes vibrant **folk music, dance performances, and fairs**, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Kullu Dussehra.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Madikeri Dussehra:**

 
 
• Celebrated in **Coorg (Kodagu)**, Karnataka, Madikeri Dussehra is known for its elaborate processions of decorated temples and folk performances.
 
• The festival reflects the unique culture of the region, characterized by the Kodava community's traditions.
 
 
 
• **Bastar Dussehra:**
 
 
• This 75-day-long festival is celebrated in **Bastar**, Chhattisgarh, and is considered one of the longest Dussehra celebrations in the world.
 
• It is deeply rooted in tribal culture and involves rituals dedicated to local deities like **Danteshwari Devi**.
 
 
 
• **Kota Dussehra:**
 
 
• Celebrated in **Kota, Rajasthan**, this version of Dussehra is famous for its fairs, cultural performances, and the burning of **Ravana effigies**.
 
• It showcases the rich heritage of Rajasthan through traditional folk dances, music, and handicrafts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Dussehra:**

 
 
• Dussehra marks the victory of **Lord Rama** over Ravana, symbolizing the triumph of good over evil.
 
• It is celebrated across India with diverse traditions and rituals, reflecting the cultural richness of the country.
 
 
 
• **Unique Characteristics of Kullu Dussehra:**
 
 
• Unlike other Dussehra celebrations, Kullu Dussehra does not involve the burning of Ravana effigies. Instead, it focuses on the assembly of local deities.
 
• The festival serves as a platform for the people of Kullu Valley to express their devotion and showcase their vibrant cultural heritage.
